dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual 2D narrowing from the maximum body width toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Visible lateral margins are smooth with no asymmetrical structural deviations or bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Dark slate-grey median pixel intensity consistent with a sub-adult or juvenile color phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Subtle, low-frequency light-pixel speckling across the dorsal surface, creating a grainy textural appearance.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the primary dark-grey pigment and lighter-toned textural speckles.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One distinct, dark circular focal mark on the anterior-left dorsal quadrant and one faint linear mark in the mid-posterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct circular dark-pigmented focal mark on the anterior-left dorsal surface.
